item.title: Xinjiang Silk Road Adventure
item.description:
Tour Overview

Explore China’s western frontier, where Central Asian cultures meet stunning natural landscapes. This 10-day adventure follows the ancient Silk Road through Xinjiang’s deserts, mountains, and oasis cities.

Quick Facts

  • Duration: 10 days / 9 nights
  • Price: From $2,200 per person
  • Difficulty: Moderate (some long drives, altitude changes)
  • Best time: May-October
  • Group size: 4-10 travelers

Itinerary Highlights

Days 1-3: Urumqi & Heavenly Lake

  • Arrival in Urumqi, Xinjiang’s capital
  • Visit Tianchi (Heavenly Lake)
  • Xinjiang Regional Museum
  • Local Uyghur restaurant experience

Days 4-6: Turpan & Ancient Cities

  • Journey to Turpan, China’s hottest city
  • Visit ancient cities of Jiaohe and Gaochang
  • Karez underground irrigation system
  • Grape Valley and local vineyard visit

Days 7-10: Kashgar & Silk Road

  • Flight to Kashgar
  • Explore Kashgar Old City
  • Sunday Market - largest in Central Asia
  • Karakul Lake with views of Muztagh Ata
  • Farewell dinner with Uyghur family

Experience the Silk Road

Contact us for this unique adventure through China’s western frontier.
